text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-cluster.hotcell-17 queue-depth > 2000 for > 3m. Alert ID: PD-98432. Trigger: metric(inference_queue_depth) = 2348. Suspected autoscaler lag.

pagerduty-bot: Paging Mike (oncall) -> escalation policy: inference-oncall. Page sent to mobile.

Mike (oncall): acked. I'm looking. grabbing metrics now.

Anna SRE: joining. seeing queue spike across hotcell-17 and hotcell-18. avg token latency to model-hosts up from 60ms -> 420ms. 5xx rate creeping to ~4%.

Mike (oncall): kube events show a bunch of FailedScaleUp events from cluster-autoscaler: "Insufficient capacity in zone" and "provider api rate limit".

Luis Infra: provider flapping on spot pools; node-pool hotcell is configured to prefer spot. quota/spot capacity looks exhausted in us-west-2a.

Anna SRE: autoscaler logs (snippet):
```
I0316 14:02:01 cluster-autoscaler: ScaleUp: nodegroup hotcell desired=6 -> 12
E0316 14:02:02 cloudprovider: error requesting nodes: quotaExceeded: Request rejected by provider
E0316 14:02:02 cluster-autoscaler: Failed to scale up: provider api rate limit (429)
```

Mike (oncall): impact check: Hosted API 95th latency spike, a small set of customers on dedicated capacity hitting higher tail latency. No full regional outage, but requests are piling in queue -> risk of timeouts. Support, prepare customer list for followup.

Maya Support: prepping a brief for customers: which endpoints show 503s vs slow responses? We saw a wave of 503s on /v1/generate starting ~13:58 UTC. I'll hold messaging until you confirm degraded state.

Carla Eng: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) force manual nodepool scale to on-demand to bypass spot shortage 2) re-route traffic off hotcell-17 to hotcell-20 (if capacity) 3) reduce batching/window size temporarily to lower per-request queue pressure.

Mike (oncall): executing manual scale now to get immediate capacity. command run: 
```
cloudctl nodepool scale --cluster=infra-prod --pool=hotcell --size=14 --type=on-demand
```

Luis Infra: also opening support case with cloud provider for spot replenishment and increasing rate limits. Setting temporary fleet override to allow on-demand fallback.

Anna SRE: while nodes spin up (~4-6m) start draining low-priority jobs from hotcell: label query `priority=low` -> `kubectl delete pod -l redwood.priority=low -n inference`. Doing that now.

Mike (oncall): rolling reroute rule: updating router rules to prefer hotcell-20 for new requests (ttl=5m). Executed.

Maya Support: posting short note to status (internal): "Degraded performance for inference API in us-west-2 due to capacity shortage. Engineers are actively scaling and rerouting. Some customers may see increased latency or 503s. We will update in 15 minutes."

Carla Eng: also adding temporary autoscaler tuning: lower scale-down threshold and reduce cool-down so new nodes are used faster. We'll revert after stability.

Anna SRE: new nodes coming up, kube join logs look good. Node count rising to 14. Observability: queue depth falling 2348 -> 980 in 3m. 5xxs dropping.

Mike (oncall): monitoring. If queue continues to drain to <300 in next 10m we'll call this mitigated. Preparing runbook notes for post-incident: consider changing hotcell spot fallback to immediate on-demand, add provider rate-limit backoff logic, and increase autoscaler retry window.

Maya Support: updated status page to external customers: brief note, advised reduced performance window and follow-up after investigation.

Carla Eng: filing action items: ACTION-1 adjust autoscaler thresholds; ACTION-2 add alert for provider rate-limit errors (429); ACTION-3 validate cross-cell spare capacity settings.

Mike (oncall): PD incident: acknowledged -> resolved? waiting for queue <300 and latencies stable. Setting thread to watch.

Anna SRE: queue at 180 and tail latencies back to baseline ~70ms. 5xx at 0.7%. Marking mitigated at 14:08 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident update: PD-98432 -> mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. Owners: Anna SRE, Luis Infra.

Mike (oncall): thanks team. I'll close PD after postmortem ticket created. :thumbsup:
